notes: What tournament needs from the chip-ledger component. The ledger state is opaque to the tournament and JSON-serialisable; the game moves chips between players through the same component. The tournament issues every starting stack and rebuy itself, so chip-ledger's startingStack setting must not add a second stack.

issue.returns: LedgerState (new chips enter circulation for that player: starting stacks and rebuys)

balance.returns: number (chips held, 0 for an unknown player)

setSeats.returns: LedgerState (each listed player's seat number recorded, so the odd chip goes by seat)
